metadataEntity.description: LICENSE body templates and OSI catalog metadata, consumed by the license template engine to generate LICENSE files for the root project or a layer. Verbatim-only: body text is migrated from hand-authored templates or fetched from an OSI source and cached as-is — never LLM-generated or paraphrased.

schemaNotes.entries: Keyed by license id (lowercase, hyphenated — matches OSI's own id slugs, e.g. 'gpl-3-0'). Shape mirrors the future config/licenseRegistry.json OSI cache described in spec-services-licenseService-v01.md §2.2, so this file can seed or align with that cache later instead of being a one-off shape.
schemaNotes.copyrightTemplate: A string containing zero or more of the tokens <YEAR>, <AUTHOR>, <EMAIL>, describing this license's own copyright-notice convention (they are not all formatted the same — compare mit's 'Copyright <YEAR> <AUTHOR>, <EMAIL>' to gpl-3-0's 'Copyright (C) <YEAR> <AUTHOR> <<EMAIL>>'). null means this license has no copyright-line concept at all (e.g. public-domain-style dedications) — in that case 'body' must not contain the <COPYRIGHT_LINE> placeholder either.
schemaNotes.body: The full license text, verbatim, with the literal placeholder token <COPYRIGHT_LINE> marking exactly where a resolved copyright line is substituted (position varies by license — e.g. GPLv3 needs its own title block before the copyright line, so this is a placeholder-in-place rather than a blind 'prepend above body' rule).
schemaNotes.resolutionAlgorithm: 1) If copyrightTemplate is null, return body unchanged (it will not contain <COPYRIGHT_LINE>). 2) Otherwise replace <YEAR>/<AUTHOR>/<EMAIL> in copyrightTemplate with the caller's LicenseAuthorContext, then string-replace the single <COPYRIGHT_LINE> occurrence in body with that resolved line.
schemaNotes.textSource: One of 'curated' (hand-authored/migrated, this file's only kind today) | 'osi-html' | 'osi-steward-text' | 'link-only' (future OSI-tier values, per spec-services-licenseService-v01.md §2.2/§1.3).
schemaNotes.metadataCaveat: spdxId/approved/keywords/htmlUrl/stewardUrl below are known facts about these well-established licenses, not the result of a live OSI /api/license fetch — this environment's network egress policy blocks opensource.org and gnu.org, so no live catalog sync has run yet. Full-catalog population (all OSI entries, HTML-scraped body/copyright text) is still outstanding — see CLAUDE.md's To-Do list.

revisionHistory.revisionNote: Initial creation. Migrated 'mit' and 'gpl-3-0' from app/templates/license/mitLicenseTemplate.ts's hardcoded if/else. Fixed the known double-'Copyright (C)' prefix bug on gpl-3-0 (authorLine already started with 'Copyright (C)', then got 'Copyright (C) ' prepended again) by splitting the copyright line out into its own copyrightTemplate field entirely, so there is no longer a second place a prefix could be re-added. gpl-3-0's body text remains the same truncated excerpt as the pre-existing file (Definitions + §5 + closing line only, not the full 17-section GPLv3 text) — the canonical source (gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt) is blocked by this environment's network egress policy, so it was not fabricated from memory; see this entry's own 'notes' field and CLAUDE.md's To-Do list.
